content.raw:
Childhood and adolescence are times of rapid physical, emotional and psychological change, and mental health concerns in these years need an assessment that takes development and family circumstances into account. The child and adolescent psychiatry department at our partner hospital offers assessment, follow-up and treatment programmes for emotional, behavioural and developmental difficulties. MedLuxLife helps families arrange consultations, share school and medical reports and plan follow-up across borders.

Treatments and services

Comprehensive assessment

Evaluation of a child's mental, emotional and behavioural health in the context of their developmental stage and environment.

Diagnosis and treatment planning

Structured diagnosis and an individual treatment plan for disorders arising in childhood and adolescence.

Family and relationship support

Attention to mother-baby-child relationships, sibling rivalry and parent-teenager conflict.

Long-term follow-up

Ongoing monitoring of mental development, including for children with chronic illnesses and their families.

Areas of care

  • Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)
  • Learning disabilities
  • Autism and related pervasive developmental disorders
  • Depression and anxiety disorders in children and adolescents
  • Feeding and sleeping problems in infancy and the preschool years
  • Mother-baby-child relationship problems
  • Toileting (bladder and bowel habit) problems
  • Tic disorders
  • Language and speech development problems
  • Childhood masturbation
  • Sibling rivalry
  • Adjustment and behavioural problems
  • Thumb sucking and nail biting
  • Intellectual disability and related behavioural problems
  • Adolescent problems and parent-teenager conflicts
  • Children and adolescents prone to violence
  • Mental health concerns in children and adolescents with chronic illnesses, and their families

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous psychological or developmental assessment reports
  • Relevant school reports or teacher observations

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Child and Adolescent Psychiatry consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
